power_and_lock.rule: the plan prelude's power-limit-w 700: the pre-setup dry run and the prelude refuse a card whose power.max_limit is under it (A2's P-W); nvidia-smi -pl 700 -sc 0, then S1's read-back: poll every 2 s, up to 30 s, until --query-gpu=enforced.power.limit and nvidia-smi -q -d POWER's GPU-scope Current Power Limit both read 700 W within 1 W (power-set.txt), else the session STOPS (c2-power.env C2_POWER_700=refused, the last reading in power-set-unsettled-700.txt, which the ledger names). No fallback limit. 900 W is not attempted: in S1's publication -pl 900 -sc 0 left the enforced GPU limit at 700 W, and S1 and (most likely) A2 ran at 700 W, so 700 W keeps C2 comparable with both
power_and_lock.lock_rule: every unit but calibrate and the census runs under nvidia-smi -lgc 1410 with ncu --clock-control none (A2's and S1's rung; v5'' is fitted there)
power_and_lock.probe: A2's lock-hold probe in its cheapest form: (1) the prelude locks 1410, reads clocks.sm back (lock_and_check, two tries), resets, records LOCK_PROBE_1410=held, and STOPS the session when it does not read back (S1's prelude probe, made a stop); (2) A2's G-BAND (tileA2_gate.py band, score_floor_a2.choose_band) after the two f128 pages: joint_cF over them in the counter band at 1410 (primary [0.975 L, L], else the registered fallback [0.959 L, L]) is not None, else the session ends there. A2's timed probe pages (27 min on A2) are not run
